about: Dystopia Shorts episodes played as in-game cinematics. Episode N adapts Book One chapter N. To add one: drop cinematics/epNN.mp4 (H.264 720x1280, AAC, faststart, no end card) and epNN_poster.jpg, then add an entry. 'chapter' is the game chapter id that covers that book chapter (ep1: 1, ch_conduits: 2 to 5, ch_harvest: 6 to 7, ch_steel: 8 to 14). 'at' is when it plays: start, door1, door2, door3, core.

episodes.title: Twenty Feet of Machine
episodes.blurb: He wakes with no memory. A twenty foot machine finds him.

episodes.title: Forty-Three Left
episodes.blurb: Forty-three people under the ruins, and a memory that is not his own.

episodes.title: They Are Stealing Our Minds
episodes.blurb: Fewer than fifty million left, and Marcus can read the machines' code.
